name: PlanetScale Skills
summary: Official PlanetScale Agent Skills for read-only assessment, reviewable Class B schema proposals, and approval-gated Class C/D changes. MIT; live ops need an authenticated pscale CLI.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (PlanetScale). The planetscale/skills repository is MIT (Copyright (c) 2026 PlanetScale), not archived. The pack is free to install. The README's safety model (skill planetscale-change-gates-and-approval-contract) classifies every operation before it happens. Assessment (Class A) is read-only: the first pass always produces a report and changes nothing. Class B work — development branches, pull requests, deploy requests, and restore tests — can be prepared without per-change approval, because the review workflow is the gate. The agent's default deliverable for a schema recommendation is the complete reviewable unit: a branch with the DDL applied, a PR with the evidence, and an open deploy request; the operator's action is the merge/deploy decision. Class C work (behavior-changing: safety flags, webhooks, roles, and budgets, including Traffic Control budgets) needs approval or authorization. Class D work (production data/availability: deploys, DDL, deletions, credentials) needs approval, a named target, and a rollback plan. Class E work (destructive without recourse) is never executed autonomously. Automate creates scheduled agent loops. The README's recommended loops include recommendation-to-PR (no authorization; it only produces proposals), a recommendation deployer (requires a standing authorization), regression watch, and posture drift check. Class B preparation already applies DDL on a development branch and opens PRs/deploy requests; Class C/D work and authorized deploys can change production schema or configuration and incur PlanetScale usage. Refund terms for PlanetScale billing were not re-verified here. No CLI auth or org access was used. Prerequisites in the README: an authenticated PlanetScale CLI (`pscale`), with agents told to pass `--format json` and to use `pscale sql` rather than `pscale shell`. An optional insights-only PlanetScale MCP server is preferred for telemetry when available; nothing requires MCP. This skills entry does not set mcp_endpoint. Documented install: `git clone https://github.com/planetscale/skills.git` then `script/setup` (installs into detected agent skill directories), or `npx skills add planetscale/skills -g -y`, or a manual copy of the sibling `planetscale-*` directories (they reference each other by relative path and must stay siblings). The setup script and npx command were not executed. https://docs.planetscale.com/skills returned HTTP 200 with an empty body (Content-Length 0) on 2026-11-16, so it is not used as url, docs or a source.
